parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Ore. I currently have 1 Sheep and 1 Ore. While I need resources to build towards the 3:1 port, giving Ore to Claude is dangerous. Claude is on Ore 3 (Hex 11) and Ore 5 (Hex 17), but he's currently blocked or on low numbers. My Ore is valuable for future cities or development cards. More importantly, Claude betrayed me in the past and is a hostile player. Trading my only Ore for 1 Wheat (which I already produce on Hex 14, 15, and 18) doesn't make strategic sense. I'll reject the trade.
